tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (307)'od gsal snying gi thig le las/rdo rje gro lod sgrub thabs bzhugs/ /(308)gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /dbang chen rngams pa khro bo'i rgyal/
(307)'od gsal snying gi thig le las/rdo rje gro lod sgrub thabs bzhugs/ /(308)gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /dbang chen rngams pa khro bo'i rgyal/

tei:div.tei:p: 'od gsal snying gi thig le las/ rdo rje gro lod sgrub thabs bzhugs// (308) gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na// dbang chen rngams pa khro bo'i rgyal// rta mchog dpal la phyag byas te// rnal 'byor lam gyi nyi ma bshad/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'khrul pa gzung 'dzin rtog ngan rgyu// rkyen ni chags sdang la sogs pa// lta ba log pa nyon mongs lnga// las kyi 'bras bu smin pa yi// bgegs rigs 'byung por gtogs pa rnams// mchod byin gtor ma chen po 'di// mang por ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed// so sor thob pa sngags kyis (309)byas// phyag rgyas pham rgyal 'thab rtsod med// tshig bshad bden pas bkrol te bsngo// sngags 'chang bdag gi bka' ma bcag /gum gum chum chum dam la 'dus/ hūm̐/ shin tu khros zhing gtum pa la// zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ khro bo de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad/ khro bo'i tshul chen khros pas kyang*// 'jig rten gsum dag bsregs byed na// sangs rgyas(310)thams cad khros pa yi/ khams gsum ma lus dbang sdud na// ma dad sems can smros ci dgos/ hūm̐ hriḥ chos sku'i ston pa sangs rgyas 'od dpag med// lnga ldan longs sku'i khyab bdag spyan ras gzigs// thugs rje sprul sku'i mnga' bdag pad+ma 'byung*// sku gsum rig 'dzin bla ma gro bo lod// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi// bar chad bdud sde'i g.yul las bskyab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ hoḥ ma dad gdul bar bya ba'i tshul stun te// srid gsum ma lus dbang du sdud pa dang*// ngan song gnas sbyangs ma rig mun khang gtib// thams cad 'jigs shing g.yul du 'brub pa dang*/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sku yang bskyed pa'i phyir// bla med byang chub gnas su 'god par bya'o/ lan gsum/ hoḥ(311)ma rig rlabs kyi sems nyid rang zhal bsgrib// ye nas dbyer med rtog pas so sor bzung*// rang byung 'du 'bral med pa'i rdo rje sems// sku gsung thugs su bsgrub par dam bca'o/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ hūm̐/ dpal chen rdo rje gro bo laud// stag tshang seng ge bsam grub tu// gdug pa'i dam sri 'dul ba bzhin// khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag gis// dur khrod rdzas la brten bcas te// gdung ba drag pos rgyud bskul na// thugs rje chen pos 'dir dgongs shig /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ sa ma ya a we sha ya pheṃ pheṃ hriṃ hriṃ sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ hūm̐/ rnam par mi rtog ye nas skye med cing*/ gzung (312)'dzin rtog med mtha' gnyis ma chags dbyings// ye nas mnyam nyid rang bzhin ji bzhin ngang*// mtshan ma'i rtog bral smra bsam brjod las 'das/ shun+ya tā dz+nyā ad+ma ko ྅ haṃ/ ma ltar byams pa kun la khyab pa'i sku// mkha' ltar dag pa cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i rgyu// kun la snyoms pa'i ye shes gsal ba dang*// yon tan rin chen 'byung ba'i dbang ldan yum/ dharmā dha tu hūm̐/ yi ge hūm̐ ni sems kyi rang bzhin te// chags pa'i skyon bral pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /sangs rgyas che ba'i khyad par bstan pa'i phyir// rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar khro bo'i sprul pa 'byung*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ las zhe sdang 'bar ba'i nam mkha' la// phrag dog g.yo ba'i 'tshub ma rgya gram ldan// chags pa rak+ta'i rba klong 'khyil zhing gtam// gti mug mun pa'i keng rus sa gzhi brdal// nga rgyal chen po'i ri rab me ri 'bar// dbang chen 'byung ba yum lnga'i (313)mkha' la shar// rdo rje me dpung dur khrod 'khor yug dbus// bh+rum̐ las dbang drag rol pa'i gzhal yas khang*// phyi ni rin chen nang ni thod pa'i mkhar/ khrag zhag 'dam 'thas gnam lcags gzer mas gtams// yid bzhin 'byor ldan rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhing*// sna tshogs yon tan gsang ba'i mdzod kyi gter/ khro bo'i 'byung gnas dpal chen rngam pa'i yum// thug chom 'ur sgras khams gsum yongs su ldir// rgya yongs ma chad tshad med dpag las 'das// tshangs pa pho mo bsnol ba'i gdung khyams la// ti ra pho mo bsnol ba'i dral ma btab// phyogs skyong g.yang gzhi sha chen thog sa bkram// nya chen 'phan dang sbrul nag za ra tshag

/chu srin rus sbal zhing chen smug po'i sgo// gza' brgyad rgyu skar (314)tshogs kyis kha bad bcas// nyi ma zla ba snang ba'i skar khung brgyan// zhing chen rgyal mtshan zhing chung ba dan 'phyar// sngon chad 'das pa'i rgyal sras rnams kyi dbyings// da lta bzhugs pa khro rgyal rol pa'i gnas// slad nas 'byon pa'i rgyal sras gshegs pa'i shul// dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i pho brang dbus// thod rus bar khyams gru chad dpag sa la/ gnam lcags rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzer mas gtam// 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi lte ba chos 'byung dbus// sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i dbus// bdud dang dam sri byi chings bsnol ba'i steng*// dmu stag mi zan shin tu rngam pa'i tshul// zhe sdang rgyas pa'i mche ba sder mo gzings// 'dod chags 'khrugs pa'i mig rtsa khrag tu khol// nga rgyal khengs pa'i hūm̐ gi nga ro sgrog (315)dbang gi phrin las mgyogs pa'i mthu dang ldan// shes rab rtsal gyis ye shes pha rol phyin// rig pa'i rlabs gyis sa gsum gcig char gnon// mkha' lding rgyal po gzan la bab pa'i tshul// rang rig gsal ba rgyu yi yi ge nyid// gdan la bab cing byang chub sems sprin las// sprul pa bsam mi khyab cing yongs gyur pas// thig le dmar po 'bar zhing 'phro bar gyur// stong pa'i dbyings las thugs rjes glus bskul te/ e ma sems can sangs rgyas tshogs bcas rnams// ma dad 'khrul pa'i log rtog sems can rnams// sngon gyi las nyon sa bon rtsub mos 'phang*// 'bras bu nyon mongs lnga ru smin pa rnams// gdul bya 'dul phyir khro bo 'chol bar bzhengs// bskul (316)ba bsan nas sku gsung thugs rje g.yos// srid gsum zla med pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// 'chi med rdo rje phyag rgya chen po brnyes// dbang drag khros pa rdo rje gro bo lod// sku mdog mthing nag stong zil chags pa'i mdangs/

baiḍūr sngon po nyi ma bye bas brgyan// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis swag lham gsol// 'dor stabs stag mo'i mgo dang 'phong steng brdzis// sgeg dpa' 'jigs rung rgod gshed drag shul 'bar// snying rje rngams dang zhi ba gar dgu rdzogs// dmar smug ber phyams chos gos gsum gyis spras/ kha dog me 'bar byi ru'i 'od 'khyil bas// sa gsum zil gnon srid gsumagazhob tu bsreg /ral pa khams nag rdo rje'i tshom bu 'khyil// me rlung 'khrigs pas zhe sdang (317)gdug pa'i tshogs/ khro bo dbang sdud 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra rngams// spyan mig me 'bar stong gsum zla 'khrugs// smin ma glog 'gyu dug gsum rtsad nas gcod// snyan cha dung lung rdo rje'i khong gseng nas// 'brug gi sgra sgrog rdo rje thog char 'bebs// shangs kyi klong nas mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshub// rgyud lnga sgrol ba'i hom zhal am gtsig bsdam// mche ba rab gtsigs ljags las 'od zer 'phro// ag tshom sma ra gdug pa'i me dpung 'bar// log 'dren bdud dang mu stegs thal bar brlag /phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga phyar// ra las skyes pa'i gnam lcags ral gri 'bar// rdo rje'i tshwa tshwas bstan dgra'i glo snying 'gems// (318)phyag g.yon sku gsum lhun grub lcags phur 'dril// zhe sdang las skyes rgyal 'gong dam sri rnams// dpa' skong zil gnon mya ngan bskyed par byed// lcags sdig nag po ser chen bzhin du 'bebs// thugs kar rin chen zla gam dmar po'i dbus// dpal chen rta mchog pad+ma he ru ka /dmar gsal 'khrugs pa dus mtha'i me bzhin 'bar// dbu lnga bcu drug phyag la zhabs brgyad bsgrad// rdo rje'i khyung shog bya khyung nyi zlas mtshan// dur khrod dpal gyis chas rnams sku la rdzogs// shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhir gzigs pa'i dbu/ steng zhal kun kyang las bzhi'i rta mgo mtsher// dri za gshin rje klu yi dbang po dang*// gnod sbyin bdud kyi tshogs la mya ngan bskyed/

g.yas (318)brgyad rdo rje kha ṭ+waṃ dril bu dang*/ lcags kyu sbrul zhags 'khor lo ral gri zhags// g.yaun brgyad thod khrag pad+ma ru tra'i snying*/ rdo rje'i dbyug pa rgya gram be con me// tri shu la dang ye shes khyung khra 'gyed// yum chen pad+ma gzi ldan baiḍūr mdog /phyag gnyis nor bu rin chen za ma tog /bsnams zhing yab yum bde ba chen por sbyor// de yi thugs kar rin chen zur brgyad dbus// gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte ba la// pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la// rang byung rig pa hūm̐ yig dmar po'i mthar// rtsa ba'i rig sngags byi ru'i phreng ba bzhin/ oṃ pad+man+ta krita h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shrī gro bo lod sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ 'od zer lcags kyi tshwa tshwa gtam pa'am// 'gal me dmar po klad la bskor ba bzhin/ (320)/'khor zhing snang bas bde gshegs zhing khams 'gengs// sgra dang 'od kyis rgyud bskul mchod sprin spros// slar yang ngan song gnas sbyangs rgyud lnga bsgral// kun kyang dpal chen khro bo'i zhing du bsgyur// gzung 'dzin rtog bral byang chub sems kyi ngang*// gdan gsum yongs rdzogs chos sku'i rol par blta// gtso bo'i spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// rdo rje slob dpon budha thod phreng rtsal// dmar smug brjid pa zhi khro'i nyams kyis sgeg /sngags kyi phod chen mthing nag sku la gsol// dbu skra thor tshugs dar mthing cod pan 'phur// sna tshogs dar dang rin po che yis brgyan// g.yas pa ḍā ru g.yon pas 'khor lo 'dzin// mi g.yo mnyam pa rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs steng pad+ma nyi zla'i dbus/(321)/rdo rje rin chen pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// karma thod phreng dkar ser dmar ljang mdog /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma'i mchod sdong dang*// phrin las lhun grub sna tshogs rgya gram g.yon// kun kyang g.yas pas thod pa'i ḍā ru 'khrol// rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo'i tshul dang mtshungs// gru chad bzhi la pad+ma bam gyi steng*// rigs bzhi'i ging chen dkar ser dmar ljang mdog

/g.yas pas rang rtags g.yon pas bhan+dha thogs// gsang ba'i yum bzhi gri gug thod pa 'dzin// kun kyang gcer bu rin chen rus pas brgyan// zhabs gnyis bzhengs stabs gar gyis rol par 'gying*// bar khyams gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma// 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa// sku mdog phyag mtshan ma nges cir yang 'char/ pho brang sgo bzhir (322)lcags kyu zhags pa dang*// rdo rje lcags sgrog rdo rje'i dril bu ma// phrin las bzhi sgrub rgyal chen pho nyar 'gyed// snang stong ma 'gags 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin// gdod nas lhun grub dkyil 'khor chen por shar/ hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams// pad+ma ge sar= ya mtshan= pad+ma 'byungs= 'khor du= khyed kyi= byin gyis rlabs= hūm̐/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// gling gi ming ni 'dzam bu gling*// gnas kyi mchog gyur o rgyan gnas// yul gyi ming ni li yi yul// rang byung mchod rten 'jig rten brtsegs// slob dpon rdo rje gro bo lod// dregs pa tshar gcod dngos grub brnyes// 'khor du karma mkha' 'gros bskor// byin gyis rlabs phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog= sgrub mchog= bgegs dang= mchog(323)dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ gu ru pad+ma sidhi hūm̐/ bde chen chos sku brdal ba'i zhing khams su// ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga'i pho brang dbus// gdul thabs sgyu mar rol pa'i gdan khri la// ye nas gnyis med lhun grub chen por bzhugs// chos dbyings dag pa dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir// ye shes khyad par 'phags pa'i gzhal yas su// dpal chen rdo rje gro lod lha tshogs rnams// gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol/ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ a we sha ya āḥ 'dod chags dag pa shes rab pha rol phyin// ma 'gags rol pa'i phyag rgya cir yang snang*// bde gshegs yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal lo// nyon mongs rtog pa'i dra ba kun bcom nas// ye shes dgu yi don dang rab ldan pa/(324)/dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/

a ti pu ho/ pra tits+tsha ho/ shraṃ na ma/ kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung chen por shar// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing khams rgyas par 'gengs// sku gsung thugs kyi dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir// me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab ma// mchod chen dbang gi tshul du 'bul lags na// dam tshig dgyes pa mchog la rol mdzod cig na maḥsarba tā thā ga ta sogs pu+eṣ+pa dhu pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe pra tits+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swa hā/ 'dod don rang 'phrul rdo rje'i dam tshig ste// gzugs dri ro reg bya chos kyi khams// rdo rje lha mo gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus pa rnams bzhes/ ru pa shab+ta gan+dhe rā sa par+she dharma ho/ dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod pa chen po 'di/(325)/'dod pa'i yon tan lha mor byin rlabs shing*// pad+ma rak+ta pañca a mṛ ta// dam tshig bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol// ha he pra we sha yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa ma ya a ral+li khā hi/ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku// bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje// pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku ni mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i sku// gsung ni mi 'gags mnyam nyid rig pa'i gsung*// thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das// sku gsung thugs ldan pad+ma rgyal la bstod// 'gro ba'i don du rang byung 'od dpag med// bkra shis yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i sku// 'jig rten mnga' bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po'i sras// rdo rje gro lod rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod// dbang drag me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/(326)khro bo'i rgyal po za byed hūm̐ sgra can// rta skad rngam pa dngos grub gter gyis mdzod// dbang mchog 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// rgyas pa'i las mdzad rad+na thod phreng rtsal// dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal/

thams cad lhun grub budha thod phreng rtsal// phrin las rdzogs pa'i rje la phyag 'tshal bstod// sna tshogs gar bsgyur thogs med phrin las bdag /rigs bzhi'i ging chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bstod// tshogs chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor sgo skyong zhing*// tshad med bzhi ldan phrin las bzhi sgrub zhing*/ gdug pa'i 'khor ba ling la 'debs mkhas shing*// dpal gyi bka' nyan skyong ma bzhi la bstod// bdag cag sems can las kyis mnar zhing gzir/ ma rig dbang gis (327)smin po rgyud lngar 'khyams// log rtog ngan pa'i dbang bsgyur 'gal 'khrul rnams// ye shes gzigs mnga' 'phags pa'i tshogs la bshags/ yig brgya brjod/ bkra shis mtshan ldan rdo rje ka pā la// dam rdzas bdud rtsi lnga dang sha chen lnga// phyi nang gsang ba sgrub pa'i dam tshig rdzas// gzhan yang 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa rnams// rnam dag byang chub yi ge gsum gyis sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bsdus pa'i dbyig /zag med kun bzang sprin gyi rol par bsgyur/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das// bsod nams can du deng bdag gyur// byin gyis rlabs phyir gshegs su gsol// yid bzhin mchod pa dam pa bzhes su gsol/ shrī badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pa sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghan+ḍe hoḥ hoḥ dung mdog sgeg (328)mo rdo rje'i spyan// sems dpa' sngon po'i ye shes 'bebs// me long lta bu'i ye shes la// badz+ra la s+ya'i mchod pa rol// yid bzhin rin chen 'od 'bar ma// 'jam dpal rnon po'i dngos grub 'dzin// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la// badz+ra ma le'i mchod pa rol// pad+ma dbyangs mkhan rma bya'i mgrin// spyan ras gzigs kyi dngos grub 'dzin// so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes la// badz+ra ghirti'i mchod pa rol// gar mkhan 'gyings po gzi ldan ma// las kyi 'khor lo rnam par 'joms// bya ba nan tan ye shes la// badz+ra nirti'i mchod pa rol// nang gi mchod pa dam pa ni// ye shes bzhi dang mnyam par sbyor// a la la ste bzhes su gsol/

shrī badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ ma le traṃ/ ghirti hrīḥ nirti āḥ spos kyi sprin lding bdug pa mo// rgyal ba'i (329)dkyil 'khor bdug pas 'gengs// byams pa thabs dang shes rab la// badz+ra dhu pe'i mchod pa rol// ut+pal mthing ga me tog 'thor// zla gam rin chen 'phro 'du gsal// snying rje thabs dang shes rab las/ badz+ra puṣ+pe'i mchod pa rol// dbang gi phyag na sgron me bsnams// chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'bar ba 'dzin// dga' ba thabs dang shes rab las/ badz+ra ā lo ke'i mchod pa rol// tsan+dan bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma// dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i thig le 'bebs// btang snyom thabs dang shes rab las// badz+ra ghen+dha'i mchod pa rol// phyi yi mchod pa dam pa 'di// tshad med bzhi dang mnyam par sbyor// a la la ste bzhes su gsol/ shrī badz+ra dhu pe dhu/ puṣ+pe pu/ ā lo ke hriḥ ghan+dhe gan/ gzugs su (330)snang ba thams cad kun// sna tshogs ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi// chos dbyings dag pa'i ye shes te// rdo rje lha mo gzugs mdzes ma/ 'dod yon phyag na bsnams nas ni// rkang pas gar byed lag stabs bsgyur// snyan pa'i glu dbyangs blang nas ni// dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul// thams cad ma lus sgra rnams ni// grags stong ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi// me long lta bu'i ye shes te// rdo rje lha mo 'jam pa'i sgra// 'dod yon

sogs/ bde ba tshim byed bsod nams mchog /tshim stong ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes te// rdo rje lha mo dri mchog ma/ 'dod yon= bde ba'i ro yi tshim byed ma// tshim stong ngo bo nyid kyi gzhi// so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes te// rdo rje lha mo bde ba mo/ 'dod yon= bde mchog dkyil 'khor yangs byed ma// rdo rje lha mo reg bya ste// 'dod yon=(331)thabs dang shes rab ldan gyur cig /byang chub sems dang mchags pa'i// gnyis su med par tshim gyur nas// tshogs chen gnyis kyang rdzogs par ldan/ shrī badz+ra ru pa oṃ/ shab+ta a/ ra sa hrīḥ spar+she traṃḥ tshogs phud dang po/ tshogs rje tshogs bdag dpal dang ldan// tshogs kyi slob dpon gshegs su gsol// gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro// reg bya chos la sogs pa yi// 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'di// bde bar gshegs la 'bul lag na// dgyes pa'i don la bzhes su gsol// mnyam nyid bde ba'i mchod pa ni// chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig pas// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa yis// lha rnams mnyes shing dngos grub 'bebs/ bar bshags/ hoḥ dbang chen rdo rje gro lod dgongs su gsol// ma rig rmongs pas ldong ba'i skye 'gro dang*// rnal 'byor dam la (332)gnas pa'i sgrub pa po// thog ma med pa'i dus nas da bar 'khor// gzugs 'dzin chags pa'i dbang gis bsags pa yi// rgyud drug bag chags ji snyed ma lus dang*// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa rnams// rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ yig brgya brjod/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ bde chen chos dbyings sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku// 'od dpag med mgon ston pa gang chen mtsho// rigs lnga rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs// dgongs pa gcig bsdus dbang chen khros pa dgongs// log spyod gdug pas khengs pa'i ru tra des// sbyor ba rtsub mos 'jig rten nyam thag tshe// khro la khros pa rol pa'i phrin las kyis// dkyil 'khor thams cad bdag la bsdu mdzad de// stong nyid snying rje khros pa'i nga (333)rgyal gyis// 'dzin rtog log pa'i bdag po 'dul ba bzhin// thugs dam bskul bas drag po sngags la dgongs/

oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐/ byang chub sems kyis gzi brjid ldan byas nas// 'phro 'du 'od kyis 'khor ba ru bzlog zhing*// rdo rje slob dpon thod phreng rigs lnga'i tshogs// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad ra mdar gnyer// sprul pa bsam mi khyab cing bsgyur la rngams/ khams gsum dregs pa'i tshogs la skyabs ling thob/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐/ chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sprul sku rigs kyi sprul pa brjod mi langs// dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas// dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ ma nyes ma len 'phags pa'i tshogs// bde gshegs rnams kyis gzu dpang mdzod// zhal lce lha (334)'dre yongs kyis chod// dgongs shig dus gsum bde gshegs dang*// sras bcas dkon mchog gsum po dgongs// bstan pa gshig pa'i dam nyams la// bsrung skyobs mgon grogs ma mdzad cig /bdag cag mi nor 'khor bcas la// sdang ba'i sems dang rtsub pa'i sems// gdug pa'i sems dang mi mthun sems// gnod pa'i sbyor ba gshams pa dang*// 'bem bca' sngags dang 'khrul 'khor bskor// phra men ngan sngags rbad pa yi// ban dgra glang snying bsam ngan dang*// mi dang mi min thams cad kyis// stobs dang nus pa thams cad bshigs// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul thams cad 'phrog /sha zo khrag 'thung khram la thob// smyo 'bog myos dang brgyal du chug /rang mtshon nus pa rang gshed phob// drang srong dmod pa'i bka' chad thong*/ e raṃ phaṭaḥraṃ dz+wa la raṃ/(335)eḥngo mtshar bsad pa'i da la ni// phyi ni gru bzhi gdengs pa la// nang ni zla gam 'bar ba yi// lte ba e rdzong dmar nag 'bar// dug gsum rang mtshon btson khang du// dkon mchog slob dpon sku dgra dang*// rnal 'byor bdag la dgos kyi dgra dam log dam tshig ldan pa'i dgra// 'du bar yongs dang sems can 'tshe// rang rgyud smin pa zhing bca'i dgra// bdag la do bsdo phod bcug zhing*// bsam ngan phra men las sbyor brtsams// ban dgra glang snying byad ma rnams// phung khams skye mched tshang ba'i gzugs// mi sdug nyams thag gzas po gsal/

hūm̐ dzaḥstobs bcu mnga' ba rdo rje gro bo lod// dbang chen gar gyi dbang phyug sras dang 'khor// sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs chen po// mchog gsum bden pa (336)dmod pa'i byin rlabs dang*// snying po sngags rgya ting 'dzin bden pa'i mthus// gang la bya ba'i dam nyams sdig chen rnams// lcags kyus zung la zhags pas ske nas chings// yan lag sdom la dril bus myos byas nas// dmigs rten mtshan ma'i rdzas la gnyis med khug rtsa sngags/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nṛ tri aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ bla sha re ma ti 'greng sogs/ bh+yo/ las byed phra men phra ma mkhan// gang la bya ba'i skyobs pa'i lha// mi dang lha gnyis dbyen gyis dbyes// mkhon chug rang gshed rang la phob/ ru tra hab le hob le shag phyes/ ru tra ma ni ma mas/ ma trag rak+ṣa shag dhe wa ni ma ra ya/ dhe wa tsan+t+ri/ dhe ba shag shag bha ri shag tsit+ta shag na phu ye shag na ga phus ya/ (337)ka kha ga gha nga*/ gha dzha ḍha dha bha yaṃ shag phyes/ hūm̐/ dpal chen gsang ba'i bka' las ni// sdig can gag zhig 'da' byed na// stobs chen khro bo thugs khros nas// rdo rje me yi ser ba dang*// drag po sngags kyis sgra chen pos// brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// dgra bgegs srog rtsa len par byed/ lok+t+ra'i sngags mthar/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'di yi srid pa spyi nas shig cig srid gsum rmang nas sgyel zhig 'khor ba gting nas phyung shig bskal pa'i mes bsregs cig bka' yi dmod pas sdig shig bka' yi chad pa chod cig gnam lcags ral gris spyi gtsug nas rgyob cig mgo bo tshal pa brgya ru thong zhig snying dum bu stong du thong zhig lus dum bu (338)stong du gtub cig rdo rje'i ser ba chen po phob cig dgra bo mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa phung du chug cig ya/ hoḥ dpal chen po rdo rje gro bo lod kyi lha tshogs las byed bka' yi pho nya rnams kyis sdig can 'di'i bla dang rdzu 'phrul phrog cig

khong nas snying phyung zhig kha nas khrag skyug cig gnam gyi 'ju thag chod cig sa yi rten phur phud cig bar gyi dmu thag chod cig ltag nas bdud g.yos cig mdun nas 'od phrog cig nye 'brel mi nor dang phrol/ gong gi phu bo dang phrol cig 'og gi nu bo dang= mchan gyi bu dang= glo bur dang ye 'grog thongs shig mi nad dang phyugs nad thongs shig klad khrag dang snying khrag dkrugs shig mda' gri dang mdung grir (339)sod cig dme gri chu gri rbab grir sod cig 'gags gri lceb grir sod cig lo nad zla gcong gi sod cig mdze nad rims nad kyis sod cig rang srog rang gis chod cig ya thod nyi ma 'de ru chug cig ma thod sa rdo 'gam du chug cig phung gsum g.yab mo thob la dregs pa'i 'dre dmag thong cig bdun rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig rtsa sngags mthar/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rā tsa'i tsit+ta zung*/ kha rag sme sha rak+ṣa rā tsa'i tsit+ta rbad/ 'khu na du bu rā tsa'i tsit+ta shig 'da' na rak+ṣa rā tsa'i tsit+ta phyung*/ ldog nā rak+ṣa rā tsa'i tsit+ta rbad/ tri'u gtub gtub rbad rbad/ tsit+ta hu lu hu lu rbad/ tsit+ta rak+ṣa gtub gtub/ tri'u (340)du tre'u du/ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭa trig nan/ hur thum dza ma ra ya rbad/ dgongs pa gsum gyis gdab bo/ hūm̐/ dpal chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas// dpal chen rta mgrin rdo rje gro bo lod// sras dang sprul pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// gnam sa gdangs ba tsam gyis zhal phyes shig /gangs ri 'bar ba tsam gyis mche ba gtsig /nyi zla 'bar ba tsam gyis spyan mig bzlog /glog dmar 'khyug pa tsam gyi ljags skyongs shig /bstabs so gdug can bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus// bzhes shig bzhes shig lhag med rol mdzod cig ma hā maṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta= ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la= ma hā go ro tsa na= ma hā tsit+ta= ma hā zhing chen la khā hi/ (341)bh+yo/ 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i zhing khams nas// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// mtshan mchog brgyad dang rnam 'phrul dpag tu med// zhi dang khro bo'i rnam 'gyur bsam mi khyab// lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje gro bo lod// ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas// ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur zhing bstob lags na// dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang*// maṃ sa keng rus sha khrag gtor ma 'bul// dug gsum gtams pa'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang*// rmad du byung ba gtor mas=

rak+ta chags pa dmar gyis= gzugs dang gzugs med tshogs kyis= dam rdzas bdud rtsi phud kyis= bya nag lug nag mdangs kyis= thugs dam bskang bas thams cad bzlog bsgyur gsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor (342)dang bcas pa yi// ma rig gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i sems kyis rlabs// dug lnga rang rgyud smin pa'i dgra dang bgegs// 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug rnams// zlog sgyur drag po sngags kyi g.yul ngo gshams// rgyab brten dpung du dkon mchog gsum po bzhengs// drang srong dmod pa'i sngags kyi mtshon cha gdeng*// ma rung zhing bcu tshang ba'i sdig pa can// bsam sbyor ngan pa'i tshogs la lings su 'debs/ gang la bya ba thal ba'i rdul du rlog /nyes med rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa la// gdug pa hom la sbyin bsregs btab pa dang*// 'byung ba'i dgra gshed sa la gshor du mnan/ chu la gtad dang rlung la zor du bskur// sngags kyi gshed bskor dbye (343)bskrad rigs sngags sbyor// glang snying byad ma kla klo gdug pa'i dpung*// zlog sgyur drag po'i phrin las dus la bab// slar la rang gshed rang gi bdud du phob// dus mtha' bstung zhing brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod/ rtsa sngags dang lok+t+ri'i shams/ trig nan myag thuṃ ha na da ha pa tsa mug mug thib thib hed hed bh+yo bzlog phaṭaḥ hūm̐ bh+yo/ thugs kar zla gam gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ gar gyi dbang phyug rta mchog he ru ka /pad+ma gzi rjid rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum// sras dang sprul pa bsam mi khyab pa'i tshogs// ma dad sems can chen po= sogs 'gres so/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam snang gang chen mtsho// rdo rje slob dpon bhud+dha thod phreng rtsal// me long ye shes rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// mnyam (344)nyid ye shes rat+na thod phreng rtsal// sor rtogs ye shes pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// bya grub ye shes karma thod phreng rtsal// rigs bzhi'i ging chen mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas// phrin las bzhi sgrub dbang phyug sgo ma'i tshogs// ma dad sems can chen po=

sogs/ dza bh+yo rbad/ bh+yo/ do nub drag po sngags kyi byin brlabs pa// drang srong dmod pa'i dmar gyi gtor ma 'di// gang la bya ba'i zhing bcu'i steng du 'phen// zlog sgyur drag po'i phrin las dus la bab/ sogs lok+t+ri'i sngags shams/ zor ma ra ya zor ya/ e sa bh+yo bzlog rbad ya/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la// 'og min gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor nas// dpal chen rta mgrin rdo rje gro bo lod/ khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i tshogs kyis gar bsgyur zhing*// ma rung (345)dregs pa'i sde dpon 'dul ba'i tshe// dam la btags pa'i dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ging*// ma sring 'bar ma pho nya las mkhan rnams// dam rdzas dmar gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma longs// bdag gi bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ rgya gar yul gyi dur khrod gnas chen brgyad// bka' bab rig 'dzin so so'i thugs mdzod brdol// dpal chen sgrub pa bka' brgyad skur bzhengs tshe// dam la btags pa'i zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// dam rdzas dmar gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma longs// bdag gi= hūm̐ bh+yo/ tshwa shod mang yu+ul dpal mo'i sgrub pa'i mtshor// dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i skur bstan nas// dam la btags pa'i dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang*// bod skyong brtan ma chen (346)mo bcu gnyis dang*// dge bsnyen byang btsan 'brog mo gnyen chen sogs// dam rdzas dmar gyi brgyan pa'i gtor ma longs// bdag gi= hūm̐ bh+yo/ sil ma la dang 'u yug mal gro klung*// has po ri dang shams po mkha' ri dang*/ ti se'i gangs dang mchims phu shel brag dang*// mkhar chu bsam yas khra 'brug la sogs dang*// khyad par stag tshangs seng ge bsam 'grub tu// dpal chen rdo rje gro lod skur bstan te// bod yul mtha' dbus gter gyi gtams byas nas// dam la btags pa'i gza' klu rgyal gsum dang*// gangs can dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs rnams kyis// dam rdzas dmar gyi brgyan pa'i gtor ma long*// bdag gi bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// phan bde rgyal ba'i bstan pa (347)bsrung ba dang*// mtha' dmag bzlog la nad gdon gnod pa srungs/

chos rgyal rje yi brgyud pa bu bzhin skyongs// sad ser mu ge byad phur rbod gtong bzlog /bka' dang dam la ma 'da' phrin las mdzod// sa ma ya dam las ma 'da' zhig rak+sha si/ hūm̐/ e yi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir// rgyud drug gnas pa'i sems can gyi// 'khor ba'i lam lnga dgag pa'i phyir// yig 'bru 'khrigs pa'i bro brdung bas// rgyud drug 'gros khung gcod pa'i rgyu// dug gsum rdul phran bzhin du bshigs// phung po khams dang skye mched tshogs// rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du// sku gsung thugs su dag sbyor bas// phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig ha ha ru lu ha ha ru lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐ hrīḥ bh+ruṃ skyes gtor ma lha yi gzhal yas khang*// yid 'ong rab tu mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan// bcud kyi dam rdzas gtso bo thabs (348)shes dang*// mtheb kyu 'khor tshogs sprul pa ging gi tshogs// skal ldan bu la gtor mas dbang bskur bas// dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i lha// sku yi byin rlabs slob ma'i lus la zhugs// bde ba chen po lus la dbang bskur bas// na tsha sdug bsngal 'khrul pa'i snang zhen sbyang*/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bde gshegs yab yum sbyor ba'i byang chub sems// dri med bdud rtsi gsang ba'i dbang chen po// phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i gsung*// gsung gi byin rlabs slob ma'i ngag la zhugs// rmad byung mi shigs gsung sgras dbang bskur bas// sgra skad zhen rtog sngags la dbang bsgyur shog hūm̐ hrīḥ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa 'od gsal ba// 'pho 'gyur med pa ye nas rgyal ba'i thugs// rmad byung gtor ma shes rab ye shes dbang*// dus gsum bde gshegs (349)rgyal ba 'dus pa'i thugs// skal ldan slob ma'i sems la dbang bskur bas// sems kyi 'khrul rtog 'od gsal chen por sbyor// skye 'chi med pa'i ting 'dzin mchog la sbyor// sku gsum rtogs pa 'bar ba'i dbang thob shog

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya/ dharma kā ya/ saṃ bho ga kā ya/ nirma ṇa kā ya/ bha ling ta a bhi ṣiñca a hūm̐/ tshad med rmad byung thugs rje'i gtor ma 'di// dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu rin po che// dbang gi rgyal po dngos grub sgrub pa'i rten// mi zad sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ āsaḥhūm̐ sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ hūm̐/ ngo mtshar sprul pa'i 'khor lo ma lus pa// ma skyes sems kyi dkyil 'khor chen por thim// chos rnams rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi ngang*// ye shes lnga rdzogs stong nyid dam pa'i mdzod/ a a āḥ slar yang khams gsum 'gro (350)'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// 'gro drug mun sel dbang chen gro bo lod// sgeg pa'i nyams kyis sgeg pa'i gar mdzod cig hoḥ lha mchog bsten cing sgrub pa'i dge ba 'dis// sems la nyams kyi snang ba nang du 'char// lus la gar gyi snang ba phyi nas 'char// ngag la bden pa sngags kyi snang ba 'char// yul snang zhen pa rgyal ba'i thugs su shar// sku gsum rmi lam sgyu 'dra'i don rtogs shog /'chi med zla gam dmar po dbang gi dkyil// skye 'chi gnyis med mgon po tshe mtha' yas// thugs rje'i sgyu ma'i rol pa rta mchog dpal// sprul pa'i khro bo 'chol ba gro bo lod// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam mi khyab// cir yang ston cing cir yang snang ba yi// gcig tu ma nges yon tan phrin las rnams// cis kyang (351)ma bsgribs khams gsum rnam par rgyal// bden pa des kyang 'dir ni bde legs stsol// stong gsum 'jig rten mi mdzed sprul pa'i zhing*// sprul pa'i gar sgyur ston pa bsam mi khyab// bstan gnyis nyi zla zung gcig 'khor zhing snang*// bden pa des kyang= khyad par bsil ldan ra ba dkar por sgyur// mthong thos dran reg byang chub lam la bkod// mtha' dbus med par rin chen gter gyis gtams// bden pa des=
'gro ba'i gdul bya so so'i snang ngo ru/ khyod kyi phrin las sprul sku 'ja' ltar shar// 'khor ba dong dkrugs mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar 'bar// bden pa des kyang 'dir ni bde legs stsol/

gro lod su dang mi mthun nag por 'dug /dag snang yin snyam rlom kyang 'khrul ni srid// mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis gshung bar ma mdzad cig /mchog sprul gang gi (352) thugs dgongs rnam par dag /kun la dag snang shar des bskul ba'i ngor// cung zad phul 'dis dgyes pa bgyid na snyam// phrin las gang dang mi mthun 'di phul lo// dge'o// hūm̐/ dpal chen rdo rje gro bo lod// stag tshang seng ge'i bsam 'grub tu// gdug pa'i dam sri 'dul ba bzhin// khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab// sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag gis// dur khrod rdzas la brten bcas te// gdung ba drag pos rgyud bskul na// thugs rje chen pos 'dir dgongs shig /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol/ oṃ badz+ra shrī gro bo lod sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ mi kha bsgyur dril thul sbad ma ra ya phaṭaḥ byad kha bzlog dang mi kha bsgyur// dam sri 'dul dang sde brgyad gzhoms// las tshogs rnams ni zur du gsal/ gro lod gter gzhung 'di nyid mkhan chen ngag gi dbang po'i dgongs gter yin kyang do gal che bas 'dir bzhag pa'o// dge'o//
